summary: Kat's monthly bank reconciliation on the migration 510 run framework: accounting_runs.subject_id (the bank account), process 'bank_reconciliation' on both process checks, the one-live-run index includes the subject, and the run guard keeps the subject immutable. Seeds Canyon Gate only: bank_reconciliation enabled (auto-post off) for NewFirst 5313 and Columbia 3170, and each account's 7/31/2026 opening reconciled position (NewFirst: three deposits in transit $4,287.18 and check 27 $200; Columbia: check 50 Texas Access Works $389.70). Creates no journal entry or ledger row.

preflight.name: accounting_runs has no subject_id yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'accounting_runs' AND column_name = 'subject_id'

preflight.name: both Canyon Gate operating accounts exist with no opening position
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM bank_accounts WHERE id IN ('2dd4bf0b-0e71-4da0-b8a7-269845ddf54c', 'ea31dca3-a435-4e9b-b72c-137ee840f6ba') AND community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003' AND opening_position IS NULL

preflight.name: the opening split entry exists, posted
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM journal_entries WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003' AND reference = 'JE-2026-00420' AND status = 'posted'

expected_changes: accounting_runs: new nullable column subject_id; process check allows bank_reconciliation; uq_accounting_runs_live includes the subject; accounting_runs_guard also protects subject_id.
community_accounting_automation: process check allows bank_reconciliation; one new Canyon Gate row (enabled, auto_post false).
bank_accounts: opening_position set on NewFirst 5313 and Columbia 3170 (were null). No other row changes.

verify.name: subject_id exists
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'accounting_runs' AND column_name = 'subject_id'

verify.name: bank reconciliation is enabled only at Canyon Gate, never auto-posting
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_accounting_automation WHERE process = 'bank_reconciliation' AND (community_id <> 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003' OR auto_post OR NOT enabled)

verify.name: Canyon Gate has three processes
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_accounting_automation WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003'

verify.name: both opening positions tie: book = bank + in transit - outstanding
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM bank_accounts b WHERE b.id IN ('2dd4bf0b-0e71-4da0-b8a7-269845ddf54c', 'ea31dca3-a435-4e9b-b72c-137ee840f6ba') AND (b.opening_position->>'book_balance_cents')::bigint = (b.opening_position->>'bank_balance_cents')::bigint + coalesce((SELECT sum((d->>'amount_cents')::bigint) FROM jsonb_array_elements(b.opening_position->'deposits_in_transit') d), 0) - coalesce((SELECT sum((c->>'amount_cents')::bigint) FROM jsonb_array_elements(b.opening_position->'outstanding_checks') c), 0)
